description: The file 'PriceServices.java' contains a class with methods related to product pricing, including calculations, rule evaluation, and price adjustments within the OFBiz e-commerce framework. It handles complex price determination logic considering various conditions, promotions, and configurations.

classes.name: PriceServices
classes.description: Contains static methods for product price calculations, rules processing, and related utilities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the price of a product given various parameters like product ID, catalog, store info, and user context, by applying pricing rules, promotions, and tax calculations.

methods.name: addGeneralResults
methods.description: Adds supplementary pricing information to the result map, such as taxes, promotional prices, and VAT calculations, based on configuration and product store settings.

methods.name: makeProducePriceRuleList
methods.description: Retrieves applicable product pricing rules from the database, optimizing the selection process based on the rule set size and filtering by product and context criteria.

methods.name: calcPriceResultFromRules
methods.description: Processes a list of pricing rules to determine the final product price, applying conditions, actions, and adjustments as specified by each rule.

methods.name: getPriceValueForType
methods.description: Fetches the most relevant price value of a specified type (e.g., LIST_PRICE, DEFAULT_PRICE) from a list of product prices, including fallback logic.
